name: Naukri Auto Updater

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs every 3 hours using cron syntax
    - cron: '0 */3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows you to manually trigger it from the GitHub website anytime

jobs:
  update-profile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        run: playwright install chromium --with-deps

      - name: Run Updater Script
        env:
          NAUKRI_COOKIES: ${{ secrets.NAUKRI_COOKIES }}
        run: python update_naukri.py
